title: fix(metadata-protocol): a packaged action or permission set's refusal names its own sanctioned path (ADR-0126 Regime C rows)
body:
Part of #20910
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

ADR-0126 §3 puts `flow`, `action` and `permission` in Regime C, and §2 requires the Regime C refusal to name the sanctioned path. Until now only `flow` was declared in the protocol's regime table, so a packaged action or permission set was refused with the hatch sentence ("Edit the source artifact and redeploy, or set OS_METADATA_WRITABLE to grant a runtime escape hatch"), and a packaged action's removal named no path at all.

Following triage's direction on the card (one regime, per-type sanctioned routes, the sentence built from the row):

- `PACKAGED_BASE_REGIME` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) is now a table of ROWS: each row is `{ regime, routes }`, and `routes` declares only the primitives the type has: `clone`, `switchOff`, or both. A row that names neither does not compile.
- `PACKAGED_BASE_REFUSAL_BY_REGIME.C` builds the sentence from the row: the lock first, then the row's paths in a fixed order (clone, then the switch), then the ADR-0126 citation. It has no type branch.
- Rows:
  - `flow`: clone (`POST /api/v1/automation/:name/clone`) and switch (`POST /api/v1/automation/:name/toggle`). The sentence is **byte-identical** to the one this replaces, and a literal pin holds it.
  - `action`: the switch only, `POST /api/v1/actions/_activation/:object/:action` with `{enabled: false}`, where `:object` is `global` for an object-less action. It carries the same operator-only clause as the flow toggle, because both routes run the one ADR-0126 §5 gate (`packages/runtime/src/domains/activation-gate.ts`). No clone is named, because the action-clone half is not chartered (§8 item 2).
  - `permission`: the clone only, spelled exactly as `plugin-security`'s own lock refusal spells it (the "Clone" action on the permission set, or `POST /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set` with a new name).
- `refusePackagedBaseOverride` (save) and `refusePackagedBaseRemoval` (delete) both use it, as before. A packaged permission set's removal stays the `supportsOverlay` carve-out (repair, not refused), so its row is reached on save only.

No code, status, route or refused write moves. The hatch still opens the lock exactly as before, and every type with no regime reads as before.

Lengths against the REST door's 500-character client-message bound (`truncateClientMessage` keeps a message only while it is shorter than 500). Characters before the item's name, save / removal: flow 411 / 404, action 365 / 358, permission 317. So an 88-character name arrives whole for every row, and that is pinned.

## Measured

**Before, on `origin/main` `7fa67dada`, the real `/meta` route handler over a real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` and `SchemaRegistry`, environment kernel (`env_1`), in process:**

- `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/pkg_action`: `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` "…Edit the source artifact and redeploy, or set OS_METADATA_WRITABLE to grant a runtime escape hatch. See docs/adr/0005-…"
- `DELETE /api/v1/meta/action/pkg_action`: `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` "…has not opted into per-org overlay writes. See docs/adr/0005-…", which names no path.
- `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/pkg_perm`: the same hatch sentence as the action.
- `DELETE /api/v1/meta/permission/pkg_perm`: not refused, the overlay-removal carve-out.

**After, at this branch, same harness:**

- `PUT action`: `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` "Metadata item 'action/pkg_action' is provided by a code package, and its packaged base is locked against in-place edits. Switch it off (POST /api/v1/actions/_activation/:object/:action, body {enabled: false}, :object = global for an object-less action; operator-only where one install serves several organizations). See docs/adr/0126-packaged-metadata-customization-model.md."
- `DELETE action`: the same sentence, opening "…locked against removal."
- `PUT permission`: `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` "…locked against in-place edits. Clone it under a new name to customize it (the "Clone" action on the permission set, or POST /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set with a new name). See docs/adr/0126-…"
- `DELETE permission`: still not refused.

**On a booted app**, the showcase (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, local mode, discovery `scoping.enabled: false`), at `origin/main`. The package door above sits behind `environmentId !== undefined` and is **not** the door this boot's `/meta` writes reach. `DELETE` of a packaged flow answers `200` "No customization overlay found … already at artifact default". So on this boot:

- `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/showcase_mark_done`: `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` "'action' is not allowOrgOverride in the registry. Overlay-allowed: view, dashboard, report, translation, email_template. Set OS_METADATA_WRITABLE to enable additional types at runtime." This comes from the repository's type door, `SysMetadataRepository.assertAllowed`, and this PR does **not** change it (see below).
- `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/showcase_contributor` (with or without `?package=`): `plugin-security`'s authoring gate answers first, already naming the clone path.
- `DELETE` of a packaged flow, action or permission set: `200`, a no-op.

## Not in this PR (why this is `Part of`, not the whole card)

1. **The named-base `ITEM_LOCKED` limb**, folded into the card by triage. Measured on the booted showcase, `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/showcase_task_completed?package=com.example.showcase` answers `403 ITEM_LOCKED` "…Edit the source artifact and redeploy, or set OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=flow to grant a runtime escape hatch on this TYPE (it does not unlock package writability, so pair it with a package-less write). See docs/adr/0010-…". The same happens for `action`, and in process on both kernel shapes for all three types. So the reach holds. But the emitter's hatch-CLOSED remedy is a pinned, ruled shape: `sys-metadata-repository.package-writability.test.ts` holds "with the hatch CLOSED the refusal still offers it — the prescription is chosen, not deleted", on `permission`, a Regime C type. Giving the limb the table's prescription would flip that pin. Per the dispatch, this is reported as a fork with options, and not picked here.
2. **The repository's type door on a kernel whose `/meta` protocol is not environment-scoped** (the booted reading above). A packaged action's in-place write there names `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE`, not the switch. It is the same ADR-0126 §2 contract at a third emitter, and it shares the decision in item 1. Both are the repository's hatch-closed prescriptions for a Regime C type, and both need the table to be readable from `sys-metadata-repository.ts`. Reported with the fork.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.packaged-base-refusal.test.ts`:
  - The old `action` control ("keeps its sentence") is replaced by per-row pins.
  - flow's sentence is pinned literally, byte for byte, on save and on removal.
  - `action` save and removal name the switch and no clone, on both kernel shapes.
  - `permission` save names its clone and no switch.
  - `permission` removal stays the carve-out (`null`).
  - The `/meta` doors throw the row's sentence (one emitter).
  - Every row stays under 500 characters with an 88-character name.
  - Controls: `page` save, and the new `object` removal, keep their sentences.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-meta-packaged-action-permission-refusal.test.ts` (new): the real `/meta` routes relay the action and permission refusals whole (`403`, `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, path named, no hatch, ending with the ADR citation), including an 88-character action name. Permission `DELETE` is not refused.
- Runs at this branch's final head `d9b1a8e8b`, which merged `origin/main` after the parallel `protocol.ts` change landed:
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 195 files passed and 3 skipped; 2906 tests passed and 19 skipped.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: exit 0. The tsconfig includes `src/**/*`, tests included.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0, with `check:test-typecheck` OK.
  - REST pins: 2 files, 9 tests passed.
- **Ablation**, committed first and run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `95cac9c9bab2` → `0c74605cac47`, restored to HEAD's blob, `git diff HEAD` empty). It deleted the `action` and `permission` rows, rebuilt `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, and `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` reported the marker absent from all 24 built files.
  - metadata-protocol pins: **7 failed** / 20 passed. All the action and permission rows plus the length bound went red. flow's literal pin and the controls stayed green.
  - REST pins: **4 failed** / 5 passed. Action PUT, DELETE and long name, and permission PUT went red. flow's file and permission DELETE stayed green.
  - Restore leg: rebuild exit 0, marker present in 2 built files, working tree clean.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `d9b1a8e8b` (no paths, change set from the merge base) derives **62** commands. All 62 were run there and **every one exited 0**.
- Reconciled with `--ran` against a `command :: exit N` record: "62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", a derived zero.
- `origin/main` has since moved 3 commits. They touch none of this PR's files, and one of them edits `scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`, which is not in this list. CI's merge ref covers it.
- The artifact-roster, wide-population, path-scheduled-job and type-check-lane families are outside the derived list and are left to CI.
- `pnpm lint` is CI's run and was not run here.
- Booted showcase at `d9b1a8e8b`: the nine readings above are byte-identical to `origin/main`'s (`diff` empty). That is expected, because that boot does not reach the changed door.

## Acceptance notes

- The booted self-hosted app (`pnpm dev`) does not exercise the door this PR changes. The change is observable on environment-scoped kernels (the in-process `env_1` harness above, and the card's own reach). The booted readings are recorded above so nobody reads "no change on `pnpm dev`" as a regression.
- The permission row's wording is a copy of `plugin-security`'s (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/packaged-permission-set-lock.ts`), because `metadata-protocol` cannot import that package. Nothing pins the two spellings equal across packages. Noted, not filed.
